text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Would you like to take a walk down the path we used to take back during our Victory Club days?"
Accepting her invitation to come along――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Baku-chan and Chiyo-chan.
Hey you two! What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Laurel-san!
I actually found something quite nostalgic!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Look, that mountain you see over there!
Doesn't it look familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's the "Jagged Mountain"!
We used to talk about what was at the top
all the time when we were kids, didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ……The summit, huh.
choice_data_list: Now that you've grown, you can take on the challenge.
Now that you've grown, you can take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ! Are you sure it's okay...?
choice_data_list: I wanna see what's at the top, huh?
I want to see what's at the top, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When I was little,
my teacher told me it was dangerous and stopped me, so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, right now...
—I want to give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh~...!
This suspension bridge sure has seen some years...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've got it! If I just dash across before the bridge collapses, it'll be fine, right?! Now, Bakushin—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wait. That's a fun idea,
but shouldn't we conserve our stamina?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the wire is secure.
Trainer, is it okay if I proceed?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Gulp, gulp... Phaaah!
"Water tastes best when you're pushing full steam ahead!" Right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hiking up mountain paths is tough work.
Let's take our time and rest as we go, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And after that, Sakura Laurel and the others
continued climbing the mountain toward the summit.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pushing through the bushes, sometimes forging a path where there was none. Eventually, what appeared before our eyes was—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowa?! You mean this is a dead end?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to just climb up and reach the goal in one go,
but that's a bit tough, isn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Fatigue is piling up, too...
Maybe we should head back for now and rethink our strategy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's suggestion makes sense.
With no guarantee we'd reach the summit,
wandering aimlessly carries too much risk—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The old me might have thought that way.
However... my resolve was made long ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because my trainee is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because she simply doesn't know what it means to give up.
choice_data_list: It's a bit of a walk, but shall we look for a shortcut?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh...! You're still going further...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure about this? If we take that step,
I'm going to push all the way to the goal, you know?
choice_data_list: Laurel hasn't given up. So I won't give up either.
Laurel hasn't given up. So I won't give up either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufu, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "You didn't hesitate for a moment, did you? ...To think you'd accompany me with such strong resolve."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled.
...Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Together with me—
please aim for the summit!
choice_data_list: Not just the summit— let's go beyond, as far as we can!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Together with me—
please aim for the summit!
choice_data_list: Not just the summit— let's go beyond, as far as we can!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting for that answer♪
Let's move forward together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Aah! Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We'll accompany you too!
We've known Laurel-san
since she was little, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, they found an ancient mountain climbing trail, and Sakura Laurel and the others pressed forward along the path—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: You're right! To make our goals come true!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! In that case, leave it to me! With my Bakushin Antenna... Hnnnngh...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I felt it, it's this way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, they found an ancient mountain climbing trail, and Sakura Laurel and the others pressed forward along the path—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right♪
Avoiding injury is the most important thing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then! If things get tough, please raise your hand!
My back is always open for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll help too!
The bond of the Victory Club is eternal, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, they found an ancient mountain climbing trail, and Sakura Laurel and the others pressed forward along the path—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—We reached the summit!!
—It's the top!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you pulled it off.
...I'm sure the reason my heart feels so clear is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I think it's because I'm looking at
this scenery together with you, Trainer♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A refreshing smile graced her face—
and it was so beautiful, it rivaled the breathtaking view before us.
